blockers.fix: wm_estimate requires a resolved positive integer full horizon, supplied explicitly or declared as scorer.horizon_s. Both declarations must agree when present. Every WM branch, estimate and verification request carries that unchanged horizon. verify_requests rejects missing/invalid horizons before sampling, and verification_candidates rejects them before building branches. Every exact branch must share the same window, start at snapshot.t0 and have duration exactly equal to the resolved WM horizon, including near episode end.

Deep-copy the observable move before constructing or scoring interventions. The estimate retains that detached snapshot; subsequent requests deep-copy it again. Replace the original identity assertion with equality and independence checks. Nested caller mutations retain the originally scored move and its hand-checked credit.

api.credit_config(cfg=None): Validate metric, direction, wm_samples, sumo_verify_fraction, verify_mode and isolated; reject unknown keys and invalid/nonfinite values.
api.assert_observable(payload, patterns=None: Reject truth-shaped keys recursively in mappings, sequences and dataclass moves. Callers remain responsible for observable sensing/V2V provenance.
api.wm_estimate(scorer, belief, members, mov: Estimate full-group delay on base, joint, solos and member reversions with paired WM samples. horizon_s must resolve from the argument or scorer.horizon_s. Missing, invalid or conflicting declarations fail before scoring. Returns outcomes, credit, isolated diagnostics, member ids, a detached move snapshot, resolved horizon and sample seeds.
api.scorer(belief, intervention, rng_child): Injected belief-only CPU scorer returning finite full-group team delay over intervention.horizon_s. May declare its registered full horizon through a positive integer scorer.horizon_s. Each intervention specifies kind, active_members, group_members, base_mappo background, unchanged horizon and optional member/move. HDVs are never commanded.
api.layer_advantage(estimate, cfg=None): Return members, team and per_member=[group_credit]*group_size for the cooperation-layer loss only, replacing its per-CAV advantage signal.
api.verify_requests(estimates, rng, cfg=None: Validate each resolved horizon, then select with the registered Bernoulli fraction independent of predicted credit. Emit detached dry all8/isolated requests preserving move, credit, full horizon, draw_id and sample seeds.
api.verification_candidates(request, plan, s: Dry ordinary-plan adapter returning candidates, branch_indices and existing sumo_verify.build_branches specs. Preserve duration/profile, deduplicate subset masks, reject background cooperation, unresolved horizons and any branch/window mismatch. No execution or charging.
api.verified_stats(records): Offline-only WM/exact D_G sign agreement, tie count and MAE. Exact outcomes never enter layer_advantage.

semantics.group_reward: utility_with_move - utility_without_move, utility=-team_delay; group_credit=D_G=base_delay-joint_delay, positive for improvement
semantics.isolated_synergy: best_solo_delay-joint_delay; solos and member reversions remain distinct diagnostics
semantics.layer_only: Broadcast the same group credit to every group member. Base MAPPO rewards, parameters and optimizers are not inputs to this module.
semantics.pairing: Every scenario uses a fresh generator initialized to the same per-sample seed and isolated copies of belief/intervention inputs.
semantics.move_identity: Estimate move is value-equal to the scored intervention and independent of caller-owned nested mutable data; request move is independent of both.
semantics.horizon: The unchanged full registered look-ahead is mandatory. The existing all8 machinery derives the exact window from duration plus its registered tail, capped by episode end. Only equal full windows are accepted; incompatibility never changes the scored move or shortens the WM horizon. A truncated flag alone does not imply mismatch if the actual full WM window is equal.
